natural_body: 40% SMB discount: +31% signups, +18% rev, -12% ret; judge at renewal

first.rationale: Current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful action. Memory_86 showed simplified onboarding improved completion rates. Rather than respond to competitive pricing pressure with promotional_pricing (memory_73 showed -12% retention risk at SMB scale), activation_messaging addresses the root metric decline directly. This approach: (1) leverages proven tactic from memory_91; (2) targets activation specifically, the metric most degraded; (3) complements onboarding work from memory_86 by nudging users after they enter; (4) preserves long-term revenue quality by driving genuine product engagement rather than discounting; (5) applies to all customer segments, not just price-sensitive ones. Verifying memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm effect sizes and any interaction patterns before committing. Enterprise_sales_assist and referral_incentive are valuable but don't address the acute activation decline. Promotional_pricing creates renewal risk documented in memory_73.
